name: RAFAEL PERINI VALLE
subtitle: PROJECT SUBCONTRACTS / CONTRACTS ENGINEER
tagline: Subcontracts · Contractors & Vendors · Claims · Cost & Measurement Control · Offshore Projects

sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Contracts- and subcontract-focused engineer with 4+ years supporting offshore/marine projects through contractor, supplier and service-provider interfaces in Brazil.
Hands-on experience with scope and service interfaces, supplier follow-up, measurements, cost control, claims, project orders and contract deliverables across multi-stakeholder projects.
3y5m as Marine Operations Superintendent, coordinating third parties, validating execution progress, monitoring deviations and supporting corrective actions, commercial records and project reporting.

MBA in Project Management with strong offshore/O&G exposure, Petrobras Drake/SAP RT experience, Advanced Excel/Power BI and fluent Portuguese/English for international contractor and client interfaces.

sections.title: Core Expertise
sections.content: Subcontract Administration · Contractor & Vendor Management · Contract Deliverables · Scope Interfaces · Claims & Change Control · Measurements & Cost Control · Supplier Follow-up · Project Orders / PO-LPO Interfaces · Progress Validation · Commercial & Technical Documentation · Contractual Correspondence · Risk & Deviation Follow-up · Offshore Procurement Support · Contract Close-out Support · Stakeholder Coordination · Reporting & KPIs

lead.title: Professional Development & Independent Projects (Nov 2024–Present)
lead.body: Career-development period focused on project controls, data handling, dashboards, SQL/Python and automation, while completing postgraduate studies in Occupational Safety Engineering. Also managed contracts, suppliers, scope, payments and delivery interfaces in independent projects. Immediately available for full-time return.

entries.role: Marine Operations Superintendent (Subcontracts, Cost & Project Interfaces)
bullets: Managed day-to-day interfaces with contractors, local suppliers, maritime agents, terminals and service providers across multiple projects, ensuring alignment between contracted scope, operational requirements and execution priorities.
Controlled service and scope interfaces, measurements, project costs, claims and supporting records, following execution status and escalating deviations requiring corrective or commercial action.
Validated physical progress and operational evidence through production, survey/bathymetry and performance data, supporting measurement discussions, client reporting and project-control records.

Coordinated procurement and service needs including materials, bunkering, waste handling, crew-change support and third-party services, with follow-up on availability, readiness, delivery and documentation.
Maintained structured project reporting, 15-day forecasts, change/deviation follow-up and stakeholder alignment with clients, suppliers, project management and international leadership.

entries.role: Operations Analyst (Contract Control & Offshore Project Support)
bullets: Supported contract administration for offshore maintenance and cleaning campaigns involving OSVs and FPSO support, tracking deliverables, personnel/material readiness, measurements and costs.
Coordinated contractor and supplier interfaces for Shell, Transocean and Helix, following mobilisation requirements, service execution, documentation and operational compliance.
Supported measurement validation, cost tracking, DPR/RDO records and contractual deliverable control, using Petrobras Drake/SAP RT for personnel and logistics compliance.
Mapped internal processes and helped prepare procedures and document-control rules for ISO 9000 implementation, improving traceability and standardisation of operational records.
Supported contractor mobilisation, transport and service requests, documentation, supplier/operations follow-up and Petrobras DRAKE credentialing for Tier-1 clients.
Spent 18 months onboard ultra-deepwater pre-salt drillships, translating SOPs and supporting clear technical and contractual communication across multinational offshore teams.
International engineering research involving technical documentation, structured data analysis and multidisciplinary coordination.
